{{Quote|There's no way he survived that fall. <br/ >Base, this is TK8252. We have eliminated the intruder. Repeat, we have eliminated the intruder. Out.|TK8252, after Kyle Katarn falls down a chasm|audio=TK8252 Moment of Glory.flac|<ref name="MotS" />}}
'''TK8252''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a [[field stormtrooper]],<ref name="MotS" /> the highest ranking [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]].<ref name="Manual">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' game manual</ref> During the Empire's [[Operation Shadow Hand]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> he worked aboard one of the two [[Imperial artificial asteroids]] that [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|fired]] on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]]. After stealing an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and New Republic [[agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] infiltrated the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], where TK8252 patrolled with another field trooper.<ref name="MotS" />

[[File:Artisteroid.jpg|thumbnail|left|200px|TK8252's asteroid base moments before destruction]]
TK8252 and his partner spotted and pursued Katarn as he explored the facility. Using [[rail detonator]]s, he fired [[rail charge|explosives]] at Katarn, blasting him into a chasm, then reported that the intruder had been [[Death/Legends|eliminated]]. However, TK8252 underestimated Katarn, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survived and weaponized the asteroid's cannon to destroy the other asteroid before setting it to self-destruct. Katarn escaped the [[space station|station]]'s implosion, but TK8252 and all other [[Imperials]] onboard died.<ref name="MotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For a long time, [the] only way I could remember [Kevin Schmitt's] number was to recite the lines from the cutscene: {{'}}TK-8252, why aren't you at your post?{{'}}|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog8" />}}
TK8252, one of two stormtroopers pursuing Katarn, first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'',<ref name="MotS" />  voiced by [[Kevin Schmitt]], the game's lead level designer.<ref name="Blog42">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|42|Insider 89 "Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum & Villainy" Endnotes}}</ref> In a [[2006]] blog post, developer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] revealed the character was named after Schmitt's phone number.<ref name="Blog8" /> Kaufman later called the character TK-825, excluding the final two,<ref name="Blog42" /> while the game's subtitles omitted the hyphen.<ref name="MotS" />
